title: Add tie-breaking logic and footer credit

requirements.text: Implement tie-breaking logic for leaderboard rankings: when two or more golfers have the same net score, rank the golfer with the lower gross score higher

quotes: if there is a tie for net score, the lower gross score should break the tie

acceptanceCriteria: Golfers with identical net scores are sorted by gross score in ascending order
The golfer with the lower gross score appears higher in the leaderboard rankings
Tie-breaking logic applies consistently across all leaderboard displays

requirements.text: Add footer text 'designed by Dancing Skeleton, LLC' to the application footer

quotes: in the footnote of the app include: designed by Dancing Skeleton, LLC

acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays 'designed by Dancing Skeleton, LLC' text
Text is visible on all pages of the application
Footer maintains existing copyright and attribution information

constraints: Do not modify the backend schema or Callaway calculation logic
Preserve existing footer attribution for caffeine.ai
nonGoals: Changing the visual design or styling of the footer beyond adding the new text
